title: INT8 weight-only profile federation, calibration CI gateway, and staged rollback playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: We ingest weight-only INT8 profiles produced by both GPTQ and AWQ toolchains. Profiles vary in schema, metric names, and sampling metadata. Current CI only runs model-level smoke tests and does not validate profile-driven quantization decisions across the served fleet. Goal: Build a profile federation layer that normalizes incoming INT8 weight-only profiles, a calibration CI gateway to run per-profile accuracy/regression checks, and an operational playbook that orchestrates staged canaries and automated rollback if regressions are detected. This ticket covers integration, end-to-end regression harness, and the rollback runbook for production rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest pipeline accepts GPTQ and AWQ profile formats and normalizes into canonical schema (tensor deltas, layer mappings, sample distribution metadata)
Calibration CI gateway runs on PRs and nightly pipelines, executing a standardized eval set that covers prompt diversity and edge cases
Regression signals (perplexity delta, token-level EM, response correctness checks) are computed and surfaced in CI with thresholds configurable per-model family
Canary rollout automation in Console is able to promote or rollback profile-based quantization variants based on CI and production telemetry
Documentation and playbook exist for on-call to follow automated and manual rollback steps, including how to pin model version to FP16 fallback
tasks: Design canonical profile schema and field mappings (GPTQ->canonical, AWQ->canonical)
Implement profile ingestion service with schema validation + provenance metadata storage
Extend calibration CI gateway to spawn per-profile eval workers with resource isolation
Add regression checks: perplexity change, soft-token distribution drift, and top-k token accuracy on curated prompts
Hook CI results to Console rollout API to gate canary promotions
Create automated rollback blueprint and on-call quick actions in Console
Add telemetry: per-profile inference error rates, latency impact, and cost-per-token delta
test_plan: CI: unit tests for schema translation and ingestion; integration tests that feed synthetic GPTQ/AWQ profiles into the gateway and verify canonical output. Regression: dedicated eval harness runs standardized prompt suite (QA, instruction-following, math, code) comparing FP16 baseline vs INT8 profile output; compute delta metrics and assert against thresholds. Nightly: run drift detector across production-like trace samples. Canary: deploy to 1% of traffic for 4 hours, monitor error/latency/regression counters, then progressively roll to 10% and 50% if metrics remain within bounds.
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Dry-run in staging with synthetic traffic
Stage 1: Canary to internal tenants (1% traffic) with extended logging
Stage 2: Canary to small customer cohort (10%) with aggressive telemetry
Stage 3: Ramp to 50% then 100% if no regressions
Rollback: automated immediate switch to FP16 or previous quantized variant if regression threshold breached
